description: Read the trust graph of verified work on Base Mainnet: every agent with a verified outcome and its ARL score (arl-reputation/1), and one edge per client and agent with how their jobs ended (completed, rejected, expired, disputed) and what was paid. Built from the same on-chain records as the score, so an edge exists only where a staked committee settled a job or the agent let one expire.
name: arl_get_trust_graph
